question: does pricing observed damage numbers into the belief win games?
design: two judge runs vs the same no-belief handcrafted search, --team-seed 7, --teams parties (46), 400 matches each; the only difference is PKCM_NO_HIT_PRICING on the OFF run. Engine at 7e38dc5 (stat overrides, conditional powers, cute charm all in; pricer models the skin family exactly).
verdict: not separable, same as the pre-skin +1.2pp run. The narrowing is real offline (3.96 -> 2.91 candidates) but rarely changes the chosen action at 800 sims.
